data.name: Flying Blade Mastery
data.description: When an attack that a flying blade makes with a dagger or starknife threatens a critical hit, that critical hit is automatically confirmed. Furthermore, the critical modifiers of daggers and starknives increase by 1 (x2 becomes x3, and so on).

raw_tokens.value: Flying Blade Class Feature.Swashbuckler Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

When an attack that a flying blade makes with a dagger or starknife threatens a critical hit, that critical hit is automatically confirmed. Furthermore, the critical modifiers of daggers and starknives increase by 1 (x2 becomes x3, and so on).
